title: ui.route 1.0
description: ui::Route (experimental): one front-end route, the game's link from a press to the screen it opens. clone_of names the route group the new one copies. The group is named by the record key alone (open_settings, not <addon>/open_settings), and that is the route name the game runs; a ui.tile route names the record by id or key.

file.description: The route file of the game it is added to: routes_frontend_general.uir.

clone_of.description: The route group of the route file it copies. Required: a record without one is refused.

opens.description: The ui.screen the route opens, by record id (<addon>/<key>) or bare key.

extends.description: Data files only: this record is a variant of that record, and its value is a merge patch on the base.
